name: @smile-savers/eais
description: Smile Savers lightweight Engineering AI Operating System (EAIS/EAOS) control-plane CLI. Reads/writes this repo's .ai/ and audit/eais/ persisted state. Isolated from the root Astro build (see tsconfig.json's own compilerOptions and the root tsconfig.json's exclude list) because TypeScript 7 does not yet have a stable programmatic API that Astro's type-checker requires -- see knowledge/architecture/typescript-7-astro-compatibility.md.
